speaker: alice
text: Right, let's dive into some fantastic environmental wins that'll put a proper smile on your face. Over in New Zealand, the world's rarest parrot just smashed breeding records.

speaker: charlie
text: The kakapo - all 235 adults left on the planet - just had their best breeding season ever with over 100 chicks hatching this year. That beats their previous record of 85 from 2019, and get this, vets even performed CPR on struggling chicks.

speaker: alice
text: And speaking of unexpected climate heroes, researchers in Switzerland found that a single beaver wetland stored over 1,000 tonnes of carbon in just 13 years. Turns out these little engineers are basically zero-cost climate solutions waiting to be deployed across Europe's river systems.
